shots.js: const g=__G.game, m=g.mission; const r={}; r.s0=m.state; g.tp(281,14,Math.PI); g.override={mx:0,mz:0}; __G.step(5); g.tp(281,10.5,Math.PI); __G.step(3); r.s1=m.state; r.obj1=m.el.textContent; g.override=null; g.tp(283.2,5,Math.PI); const near=g.nearestCar(); r.nearIsGuest=near===m.car; g.toggleCar(); __G.step(2); r.s2=m.state; r.target=m.target; r.timeAllowed=Math.round(m.left); const c=m.car; const t=m.target; const money0=g.P.money; c.place(t.x, t.z+12*(t.z>0?-1:1), t.z>0?0:Math.PI); g.override={throttle:0.5,steer:0}; let i=0; while(m.state==='drive'&&i<400){ const d=Math.hypot(t.x-c.x,t.z-c.z); g.override={throttle: d>4?0.35:-1, steer:0}; __G.step(1); i++; } g.override={throttle:0,steer:0}; __G.step(30); r.s3=m.state; r.log=m.log; r.paid=g.P.money-money0; r.objText=m.el.textContent; g.toggleCar(); __G.step(200); r.s4=m.state; g.tp(281,10.5,Math.PI); __G.step(3); r.s5=m.state; r.car2=!!m.car; if(m.car){ g.crime(2,'test'); __G.step(3); r.s6=m.state; r.log2=m.log[m.log.length-1]; } g.wanted=0; r
